description: APPLICATION FOR DEMOLITION OF EXISTING GARAGE BUILDINGS AND CONSTRUCTION OF SINGLE-STOREY SIDE AND REAR EXTENSION, TWO-STOREY FRONT AND SIDE EXTENSION AND ROOF EXTENSIONS, INCLUDING REAR DORMER WINDOW.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:
Drawing no: LOC (Site Location Plan) Dated October  2025 
Drawing no. 110 (Proposed Site  Plan And Block Floor Plan) Dated October  2025
Drawing no. 110 (Proposed Ground Floor Plan) Dated October 2025 
Drawing no: 111 (Proposed First Floor Plan) Dated October 2025  
Drawing no: 112 (Proposed Second Floor Plan) Dated October 2025   
Drawing no: 112 (Proposed Roof Plan) Dated October 2025   
Drawing no.120(Proposed Front Elevation Plan) Dated October 2025
Drawing no. 121(Proposed Rear Elevation Plan) Dated October 2025
Drawing no. 122(Proposed South Elevation Plan) Dated October 2025
Drawing no. 123(Proposed North Elevation Plan) Dated October 2025
Drawing no. 124(Proposed Street Elevation Plan) Dated October 2025
Drawing no. 125(Proposed Street Cross Section Plan)Dated October 2025 
Design and Access Statement Dated 14th November 2025 _ rev A 
Drawing no. 002 (Tree Protection Plan))Dated 06/11/2025 .
 
Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form and on the approved plans unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - Provision of Vehicle Parking - The vehicle parking area (including any garages hereby approved) shown on the approved plans shall be provided for the lifetime of the development and shall be retained for parking purposes for occupiers and users of the development and for no other purpose.
Condition : 5 - Obscured Glazing - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the windows in the north facing side elevation at first and second floor level shall be glazed with obscured glass and shall be maintained as such thereafter.
Condition : 6 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.
Condition : 7 - Tree Protection - The development shall be carreid out in accordance with the Arboricultural Impact Assessment and Tree Protection Plan, drafted in accordance with the recommendations and guidance set out in BS 5837:2012, by tga consultants.  The details and measures as approved shall be retained and maintained, until the completion of all site operations.
Condition : 8 - INFORMATIVE (Party Wall Act) - The applicant is advised to check the requirements of the Party Wall Act 1996 relating to work on an existing wall shared with another property, building on the boundary with a neighbouring property, or excavating near a neighbouring building. Further information is available at the following link: 
https://www.gov.uk/party-walls-building-works
Condition : 9 - INFORMATIVE
The London Borough of Merton's Environmental Health Service set out that normally the hours for noisy works are:
8am - 6pm on Monday to Friday
8am - 1pm on Saturday
no noisy works on Sundays and Bank Holidays
Further details can be found here: https://www.merton.gov.uk/communities-and-neighbourhoods/noise-nuisance/report-nuisance/building-noise
Condition : 10 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved without delay.
